.. _howto-adding-anthropic-llm-provider:

How-To: Adding Anthropic as an LLM Provider
===========================================

Goal
----

Register Anthropic as an LLM provider in Smarter, with the Claude Sonnet
model, so that Smarter resources and Claude Code can use it.

This is a one-time task for a Smarter administrator. Programmers who want to
use the provider from Claude Code should follow
:ref:`getting-started-claude-code` afterwards.

Prerequisites
-------------

- Comfort with the command line and with reading and writing YAML.
- A basic idea of how REST APIs use API keys.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes-style manifests is helpful but not required.

Setup
-----

Before you start, make sure you have:

- Smarter v0.11.0 or later, running and reachable.
- An administrator account on the Smarter web console.
- The Smarter CLI installed and logged in. See the
  `Smarter CLI documentation <https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-framework/smarter-cli.html>`__.
- Shell access to the Smarter deployment, so you can edit ``.env``.
- An editor. VS Code with the Smarter YAML extension gives validation and
  auto-completion for manifests.
- An Anthropic account at `console.anthropic.com <https://console.anthropic.com/>`__.

To create the Anthropic key, sign in to the console, go to
**Settings → API Keys → Create Key**, give it a descriptive name such as
``smarter-napl-prod``, and copy the value straight away. It is shown only
once.

.. danger::

   Never commit API keys to version control.

Concept Overview
----------------

Smarter has two kinds of LLM provider:

- **Built-in providers** (OpenAI, GoogleAI, MetaAI) are registered
  automatically at deployment. They only need an API key in ``.env``.
- **Additional providers**, including Anthropic, need *both* an API key in
  ``.env`` *and* a Provider manifest applied with the CLI.

Smarter manages every resource the same way: you write a YAML file called a
Smarter API Manifest (SAM) and apply it with the CLI. A manifest has four
parts:

- ``apiVersion``: always ``smarter.sh/v1``.
- ``kind``: ``Provider`` for this task.
- ``metadata``: the resource's name, description and version.
- ``spec``: the configuration. For a provider, this is which backend and
  which model.

When you apply a Provider manifest, Smarter calls the provider's API, checks
that the model is reachable, and marks the provider verified. Each manifest
registers one model, so a second Claude model means a second manifest.

The data points you need are:

.. list-table::
   :header-rows: 1
   :widths: 30 30 40

   * - Data point
     - Where it goes
     - Value for this example
   * - Anthropic API key
     - ``SMARTER_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`` in ``.env``
     - ``sk-ant-...`` (from the Anthropic console)
   * - Resource name
     - ``metadata.name``
     - ``anthropic-sonnet``
   * - Description and version
     - ``metadata.description``, ``metadata.version``
     - Free text, and ``1.0.0``
   * - Provider name
     - ``spec.provider.name``
     - ``anthropic``
   * - Model identifier
     - ``spec.provider.model``
     - ``claude-sonnet-4-6``

.. note::

   Claude Code is a coding agent that *calls* Claude models through
   Anthropic's API. It is not a model, so it is not registered here. You
   register the provider and the model it will use.

Step-by-Step
------------

**Step 1. Add the key to Smarter.**
Add the key to the ``.env`` file at the root of the Smarter deployment, then
restart so it is loaded:

.. code-block:: bash

   SMARTER_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
   make restart

**Step 2. Generate a template.**

.. code-block:: bash

   smarter manifest provider

The output is a valid example manifest. Keep it as a reference for the next
step.

**Step 3. Write the manifest.** Save this as ``anthropic-sonnet.yaml``:

.. code-block:: yaml

   apiVersion: smarter.sh/v1
   kind: Provider
   metadata:
     name: anthropic-sonnet
     description: Anthropic Claude Sonnet, for NAPL custom programming
     version: 1.0.0
   spec:
     provider:
       name: anthropic
       model: claude-sonnet-4-6

.. note::

   Model identifiers are case-sensitive and must match Anthropic's published
   names exactly. Check `Anthropic's documentation <https://docs.anthropic.com/>`__
   for the current list.

**Step 4. Apply the manifest.**

.. code-block:: bash

   smarter apply -f anthropic-sonnet.yaml

Smarter registers the provider and starts its verification checks.

**Step 5. Confirm the provider is active.**

.. code-block:: bash

   smarter describe provider anthropic-sonnet

Look for the ``status`` section. Verification runs asynchronously, so if it
shows ``pending``, wait 30 seconds and run the command again. You can also
open **Providers** in the web console sidebar and check that
``anthropic-sonnet`` is listed as active.

Proof of Concept
----------------

The output of ``smarter describe provider anthropic-sonnet`` should echo your
manifest and end with a ``status`` block like this:

.. code-block:: yaml

   status:
     verified: true
     active: true

``verified: true`` means Smarter made a live call to Anthropic with your key
and confirmed the model is ready for use.

Troubleshooting
---------------

**Startup error: "API key not found".**
   ``SMARTER_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`` is missing from ``.env``, or Smarter has not
   been restarted since you added it. Run ``make restart``.

**Provider status shows "verification failed".**
   The Anthropic key is invalid or has been revoked. Create a new key in the
   Anthropic console, update ``.env``, and restart.

**Apply error: "Model not found".**
   The ``model`` value does not match Anthropic's identifier. Identifiers are
   case-sensitive, so copy the name exactly.

**Manifest validation errors.**
   The cause is almost always YAML indentation. Compare your file with the
   output of ``smarter manifest provider``.

**Status stays ``pending``.**
   Verification is asynchronous. Wait 30 seconds and describe the provider
   again before investigating further.

.. seealso::

   - `Smarter Provider <https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-resources/smarter-provider.html>`__
   - `Smarter API Manifests <https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-resources/provider/manifest.html>`__
   - `Anthropic API documentation <https://docs.anthropic.com/>`__
